content.text:
This enumeration type determines the hash algorithm to be used when creating a digital signature.
The enumeration values are associated as defined in Table 89.

tables.title: Table 88 hash protocol
tables.table_md:
Table 88 hash protocol

| UID | Name | Format |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 00 00 00 05 00 00 04 0D | hash_protocol | Enumeration_Type, 0, 15 |

tables.title: Table 89 hash protocol Enumeration Values
tables.table_md:
Table 89 hash protocol Enumeration Values

| Enumeration Value | Associated Value |
|---|---|
| 0 | None |
| 1 | SHA 1 |
| 2 | SHA 256 |
| 3 | SHA 384 |
| 4 | SHA 512 |
| 5-15 | Reserved |
